animal.en: Many wild animals live in the forest near our city.
animal.cn: 我们城市附近的森林里有很多野生动物。

dog.en: My dog runs to me as soon as I get home.
dog.cn: 我一回家小狗就向我跑来。

cat.en: The cat is on the chair.
Our cat sleeps in the sun by the window every afternoon.
cat.cn: 我们的猫每天下午都在窗边的阳光里睡觉。

bird.en: Many birds sing in the tree outside my window.
bird.cn: 很多鸟在我窗外的树上唱歌。

fish.en: We have three goldfish in a big glass bowl.
fish.cn: 我们在一个大玻璃缸里养了三条金鱼。

rabbit.en: The little rabbit hops happily on the green grass.
rabbit.cn: 小兔子在绿草地上欢快地蹦跳。

panda.en: Pandas eat bamboo and sleep most of the day.
panda.cn: 熊猫吃竹子，一天大部分时间都在睡觉。

zoo.en: Last Sunday we saw many animals at the zoo.
zoo.cn: 上个周日我们在动物园看了很多动物。
